title: Exam room
moment: A quiet pause before or after an exam
focus: Rest your attention on one concrete detail in the room

segments.label: Settle
segments.text: You might let your attention rest on the quiet of the room for a moment.

segments.label: Notice
segments.text: If you like, notice one concrete detail: the surface of the desk under your hands, the steady hush in the room, or the light from the window. You can let your attention stay with whichever you choose. If it feels okay, you might also notice the feeling of the air as you breathe, only if you want to.

segments.label: Choose
segments.text: There is nothing you need to do here. You can stay with one detail, or let your attention move gently between them.

segments.label: Close
segments.text: When you are ready, you can return to the menu.

exit.language: You can stop at any time and return to the menu.
